content: Ezetimibe/Simvastatin tablets, marketed under the brand name VYTORIN, are supplied in various strengths and packaging configurations. Below are the detailed descriptions and handling instructions for each strength: 1. VYTORIN 10/10 Tablets These tablets are white to off-white, capsule-shaped, and have the code 311 imprinted on one side. They are available in the following packaging options: Bottles of 30 (NDC 66582-311-31) Bottles of 90 (NDC 66582-311-54) Bottles of 1,000 (NDC 66582-311-82) – If repackaged into blister packs, opaque or light-resistant blisters must be used. Bottles of 10,000 (NDC 66582-311-87) – If repackaged into blister packs, opaque or light-resistant blisters must be used. Unit dose packages of 100 (NDC 66582-311-28). 2. VYTORIN 10/20 Tablets These tablets are white to off-white, capsule-shaped, and have the code 312 imprinted on one side. They are available in the following packaging options: Bottles of 30 (NDC 66582-312-31) Bottles of 90 (NDC 66582-312-54) Bottles of 1,000 (NDC 66582-312-82) – If repackaged into blister packs, opaque or light-resistant blisters must be used. Bottles of 10,000 (NDC 66582-312-87) – If repackaged into blister packs, opaque or light-resistant blisters must be used. Unit dose packages of 100 (NDC 66582-312-28). 3. VYTORIN 10/40 Tablets These tablets are white to off-white, capsule-shaped, and have the code 313 imprinted on one side. They are available in the following packaging options: Bottles of 30 (NDC 66582-313-31) Bottles of 90 (NDC 66582-313-54) Bottles of 500 (NDC 66582-313-74) – If repackaged into blister packs, opaque or light-resistant blisters must be used. Bottles of 5,000 (NDC 66582-313-86) – If repackaged into blister packs, opaque or light-resistant blisters must be used. Unit dose packages of 50 (NDC 66582-313-52). 4. VYTORIN 10/80 Tablets These tablets are white to off-white, capsule-shaped, and have the code 315 imprinted on one side. They are available in the following packaging options: Bottles of 30 (NDC 66582-315-31) Bottles of 90 (NDC 66582-315-54) Bottles of 500 (NDC 66582-315-74) – If repackaged into blister packs, opaque or light-resistant blisters must be used. Bottles of 2,500 (NDC 66582-315-66) – If repackaged into blister packs, opaque or light-resistant blisters must be used. Unit dose packages of 50 (NDC 66582-315-52). Storage Instructions Store the tablets at a controlled room temperature of 20–25°C (68–77°F). Keep the container tightly closed to protect the tablets from moisture and light. For bottles containing 10,000 (VYTORIN 10/10 and 10/20), 5,000 (VYTORIN 10/40), or 2,500 (VYTORIN 10/80) tablets, ensure they are stored at the specified temperature range and in their original container until the time of use. If the product container is subdivided, the tablets must be repackaged into a tightly-closed, light-resistant container. Upon opening the original container, the entire contents must be repackaged immediately to maintain product integrity.
